{{velocity output="false"}} ## Velocity macros shared by the JIRA administration section (JIRA.JIRAConfigSheet) and the service handling the JIRA ## instances (JIRA.JIRAConfigService).
## Sets $jiraDeploymentTypeLabels: the labels of the deployment types, by deployment type. Data Center (stored as an ## empty value) comes first, then the deployment types contributed by extensions through the ## org.xwiki.contrib.jira.deploymenttype UIX extension point. #macro (jiraConfigDeploymentTypeLabels) #set ($jiraDeploymentTypeLabels = {}) #set ($discard = $jiraDeploymentTypeLabels.put('', $services.localization.render('jira.config.deploymentType.datacenter'))) #foreach ($uix in $services.uix.getExtensions('org.xwiki.contrib.jira.deploymenttype', {'sortByParameter': 'order'})) #set ($uixParameters = $uix.parameters) #set ($deploymentType = "$!uixParameters.deployment_type") #if ($deploymentType != '' && !$jiraDeploymentTypeLabels.containsKey($deploymentType)) ## Fallback on the deployment type itself when its label is not translated. #set ($deploymentTypeLabel = $deploymentType) #if ("$!uixParameters.translation_key" != '' && "$!services.localization.get($uixParameters.translation_key)" != '') #set ($deploymentTypeLabel = $services.localization.render($uixParameters.translation_key)) #end #set ($discard = $jiraDeploymentTypeLabels.put($deploymentType, $deploymentTypeLabel)) #end #end #end
## Sets $jiraAuthenticationTypeLabels: the labels of the authentication types, by authentication type ("No ## authentication" first, then the authentication types contributed through the org.xwiki.contrib.jira.authconfig UIX ## extension point), and $jiraAuthenticationDisplayers: the reference of the page displaying and saving the settings of ## each authentication type that has settings. #macro (jiraConfigAuthenticationTypes) #set ($jiraAuthenticationTypeLabels = {}) #set ($discard = $jiraAuthenticationTypeLabels.put('noAuth', $services.localization.render('jira.config.auth.noAuth'))) #set ($jiraAuthenticationDisplayers = {}) #foreach ($uix in $services.uix.getExtensions('org.xwiki.contrib.jira.authconfig')) #set ($uixParameters = $uix.parameters) #set ($authenticationType = "$!uixParameters.config_id") #if ($authenticationType != '' && !$jiraAuthenticationTypeLabels.containsKey($authenticationType)) #set ($authenticationTypeLabel = $authenticationType) #if ("$!uixParameters.translation_key" != '' && "$!services.localization.get($uixParameters.translation_key)" != '') #set ($authenticationTypeLabel = $services.localization.render($uixParameters.translation_key)) #end #set ($discard = $jiraAuthenticationTypeLabels.put($authenticationType, $authenticationTypeLabel)) #if ("$!uixParameters.config_displayer_reference" != '') #set ($discard = $jiraAuthenticationDisplayers.put($authenticationType, $uixParameters.config_displayer_reference)) #end #end #end #end
## Sets $jiraShowDeploymentType: whether the deployment type is displayed, i.e. when some extension contributes ## deployment types other than Data Center, or when an instance uses a deployment type whose extension is not installed ## anymore. #macro (jiraConfigShowDeploymentType $jiraConfigDoc) #set ($jiraShowDeploymentType = !$services.uix.getExtensions('org.xwiki.contrib.jira.deploymenttype').isEmpty()) #foreach ($jiraInstance in $jiraConfigDoc.getObjects('JIRA.JIRAConfigClass')) #if ("$!jiraInstance.getValue('deploymentType')" != '') #set ($jiraShowDeploymentType = true) #end #end #end {{/velocity}}
